summary: Nora's account of each room is now revised when the room has said enough to revise from (200 new messages) or after a week with anything new, instead of every day.
details: A busy room is revised about every four days; quieter rooms about weekly. A room with nothing new is still never revised.
The [culture] fold_interval_seconds setting is removed; wake_batch and stale_seconds replace it.
People's accounts and the group's account wake on their own counts, not the room's.
